machine.description: Automated multi-plunger encapsulation press utilizing Epoxy Molding Compound (EMC) pellets to hermetically seal wire-bonded semiconductor assemblies at 175°C under high hydraulic transfer pressure.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Wire-bonded leadframes are loaded into precision-machined upper and lower mold chases. Pre-heated solid EMC pellets are injected by multi-plunger hydraulic rams into runner channels, encapsulating chips without wire sweep. Degassing vacuum prevents internal micro-voiding.
subsystems: Precision Upper & Lower Mold Chases with Cartridge Heaters
Pellet Loading Shuttle & Top-Bottom Ejector Pin Bar

components.name: Hydraulic Transfer Plunger
components.function: Compresses melted EMC resin pellets into mold cavities under 120-180 bar.
components.importantParameters: Ram pressure (bar), transfer velocity (mm/s), plunger load (kN).
components.degradationIndicators: Hydraulic pressure surge (>165 bar), piston seal leakage, plunger friction.

components.name: Mold Chase Heater Platens
components.function: Maintains upper and lower mold cavities at 170-180°C curing temp.
components.importantParameters: Platen temperature (°C), temperature uniformity across chase (±2°C).
components.degradationIndicators: Thermal gradient (>5°C), heater cartridge resistance drift.

components.name: Mold Cavity Air Vents
components.function: Allows trapped air to escape during resin transfer to prevent voids.
components.degradationIndicators: Resin flash accumulation in vents, mold void defects.

sensors.name: Hydraulic Pressure
sensors.purpose: Monitors transfer plunger hydraulic line pressure.

sensors.name: Plunger Load
sensors.purpose: Measures mechanical force applied to epoxy transfer plunger.

warning.description: Vent resin buildup or high viscosity

critical.description: Plunger binding and severe wire sweep risk

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Mold release agent applied every 25 shots, vacuum < 1 kPa
operatingConditions.maximumContinuousOperation: 250 operating hours before ultrasonic mold chase cleaning

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Air vent ultrasonic cleaning and resin flash descaling
maintenance.procedureSummary: Remove mold insert plates, immerse in ultrasonic cleaning bath with alkaline solvent.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Piston seal ring inspection and hydraulic fluid replacement
maintenance.procedureSummary: Inspect polyurethane seal rings for extrusion wear, flush hydraulic reservoir with ISO VG 46 oil.

degradationIndicators.physicalPhenomenon: Cylinder seal friction & resin vent obstruction
degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Causes incomplete filling (short shot) and leadframe flash bleed

degradationIndicators.physicalPhenomenon: Cartridge heater aging and thermocouple thermal lag
degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Non-uniform cure causing package warpage and delamination
